policy: Pre-existing diseases are not covered for the first 36 months.
Room rent is covered up to ₹5,000 per day.
A co-payment of 20% applies to every claim after age 60.
Cataract surgery is covered only after a waiting period of 2 years.
Claims must be filed within 30 days of discharge.
The policy does not cover treatment outside India.
Ambulance charges are covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.
If you miss the renewal date by more than 30 days, the policy lapses.
Cosmetic surgery is not covered unless it is needed after an accident.
